name: Talha Rehman
summary: I build full-stack web applications end to end — from database design to a polished, responsive UI — and I'm now bringing AI into the products I ship. My AI engineering work spans RAG implementation, fine-tuning and comparing models, and building with the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, plus n8n automation that connects LLMs to real business workflows. Currently maintaining live client products at LiveTalk.
objective: My focus is shifting toward Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning — applying AI to real-world products and building intelligent systems on top of solid full-stack fundamentals.
background: I have hands-on experience building and shipping production web applications using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL. I currently maintain live client products at LiveTalk, and previously delivered three internal products end to end during a six-month internship at Brandora — the company website, an internal office management tool, and an interactive web game. Recent work includes an ERP-style inventory and operations module built into an LLM-powered pharmacy platform (Final Year Project), a geospatial restaurant-discovery app, and n8n workflows that tie REST APIs, databases, and LLMs together to automate manual processes. I'm comfortable with ERP-style business systems, and I enjoy owning a feature end to end — from API design through UI to deployment — in an Agile team.

workingApproach.title: How I Work
workingApproach.subtitle: The same loop on every project, from first call to long-term support.

steps.description: I dig into the actual business need before writing a line of code, and ask the questions that surface the real constraints.
I turn that understanding into a clear objective and a written set of requirements, broken into concrete tasks.
I walk the requirements back through the client or team and get agreement before building, so we don't pay for rework later.
Implementation ships in small, reviewable increments, so progress stays visible and course corrections stay cheap.
Every change gets tested before it moves forward — edge cases, API contracts, and the paths real users take.
I take the tested work to production and verify it behaves the same way there as it did locally.
I stay responsible for what I ship and remain available for fixes, monitoring, and ongoing improvements.

availability: Available immediately for onsite, remote, or hybrid roles.
